title: Obstruct the small nominal-L2 dissipative-form shortcut
statement: For0<->A+B,B<->2B,lambdaA=lambdaB=1,F_K(n)=sum_(j<=K)binom(n,j),u_n=(n,0),v_n=(n+1,1), let all AB-birth rates multiply1+delta,AB-death1-delta,others unchanged. Put t=delta/(1-delta),f(u)=1,f(v)=1+t,zero elsewhere. Exact <f,Ltilde f>/(c pi(u)F_K(n))=delta^2/(1-delta)-(1+t)^2[(1+delta)F_K(n+2)+F_K(n+1)]/[(n+1)F_K(n)]. Since ||f||_pi^2=pi(u)[1+(1+t)^2/(n+1)], the Rayleigh ratio is asymptotic c delta^2 n^K/[(1-delta)K!] and tends to+infinity for fixed0<delta<1/4 and augmentedK>0. Thus independent errors are not a uniformly small dissipative-form perturbation in nominalL2 even with nominal LSI/sector. The SAME trap has a complete robust positive compiler under its actual perturbed law; no robust impossibility follows.
